protocol: Single equipment-test participant at 15,000 ft for 25 minutes. The trial included a short voluntary hyperventilation segment.
outcome_window: During the described test. Later clinical DCS surveillance and event-free follow-up are unavailable.
locator: Trial Protocol, Experiments 1 and 2, and Discussion, pp. 44–46
note: A single healthy male volunteer participated in the equipment tests. The authors report no subjective or objective hypoxia symptoms in two monitored profiles. No DCS-specific ascertainment or standardized delayed follow-up is reported.
